def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    
    # Bins that can exactly fit the item get highest priority
    exact_fit = np.isclose(bins, item)
    scores[exact_fit] = 2 * np.max(bins) + bins[exact_fit]
    
    # Bins with capacity > item get next priority
    fits = (bins > item) & ~exact_fit
    scores[fits] = np.max(bins) + bins[fits]
    
    # All other bins get lowest priority, but still ranked by capacity
    remaining = ~(exact_fit | fits)
    scores[remaining] = bins[remaining]
    
    return scores

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.

    remaining = bins - item

    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid = remaining >= 0

    nonzero = bins > 0
    valid_mask = valid & nonzero
    priority_scores[valid_mask] = 1 - (remaining[valid_mask] / bins[valid_mask])
    return priority_scores

algorithm: {We prioritize bins by first preferring those with remaining capacity exactly equal to the item, then those with remaining capacity larger than the item but penalizing excess capacity, and finally any other bins, with ties broken by larger remaining capacity.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    
    # Bins that can exactly fit the item get highest priority
    exact_fit = np.isclose(bins, item)
    scores[exact_fit] = 2 * np.max(bins) + bins[exact_fit]
    
    # Bins with capacity > item get next priority, but subtract excess as penalty
    fits = (bins > item) & ~exact_fit
    scores[fits] = np.max(bins) + (bins[fits] - item)
    
    # All other bins get lowest priority, but still ranked by capacity
    remaining = ~(exact_fit | fits)
    scores[remaining] = bins[remaining]
    
    return scores

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.

    Return:

    """
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    mask = bins >= item
    new_fill = 1.0 - (bins[mask] - item)
    fractions = np.array([0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.875])

    return priority_scores
